title: grindelia stricta var. collina
intro: Grindelia stricta var. collina, commonly known as Gumweed, is a plant species in the daisy family, characterized by its yellow flowers and bitter, milky sap. It is used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it a popular remedy for skin conditions and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Gumweed include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Grindelia stricta var. collina include sesquiterpene lactones and sesquiterpene glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
